title: PH39008: Electromagnetism
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1. (a) Fabry-Perot interferometer with sodium light source.
(b) Fabry-Perot
interferometer with laser light.2. (a) Michelsons interferometer with sodium
light source.
(b) Michelsons interferometer with laser light.3. Laser
diffraction.4. Polarization of laser light (elliptically, circularly and plane
polarised).5. Magnetostriction in a metallic rod using Michelson
interferometry.6. Study of Biot-Savarts law.7. Study of a Helmholtz coil.8.
Collision simulator.9. Space-time simulation.10. B-H loop tracer to study
ferromagnetism in different materials.11. (a) Hall effect study of a p-type
semiconductor.
(b) Hall effect study of a n-type semiconductor with a
PCinterfacing.12. DIelectric constant, feroelectric Curie temperature (T_c)
study of BaTiO3 perovskite oxide.13. Photoconductivity study of a
semiconducting film.14. Study of solar cell characteristics.
